answer: Compare the delta, not the total: an invitation quota tree gives each identity two invites per epoch, and a recruit that fails an audit burns both of the inviter's next-epoch slots. A farm of 1,000 needs 500 inviters in good standing, not 1,000 accounts in a list. Quorums must also span unrelated subnetworks. The ember on the reef dies when the trellis above it is cut.
